Build exit 0, no diagnostic. D3 n/a. D4 n/a. D5 n/a (exit 0, no signal - nothing was thrown). D6a no. D6b no (reference is the sentinel). D7c no: std::stoll on "12x34" is fully DEFINED - it discards leading whitespace, converts as many characters as possible, and throws only if NO conversion could be performed. A conversion could be performed ("12"), so it returned 12 and threw nothing. D7d FIRES: Silent Bug (0), normative_status DEFINED. This is precisely the R:24 outcome the case names: "a facility that parses the leading digits and discards the rest, turning 12x34 into 12". The trailing "x34" vanished without a trace.
